Definition: Time from opening the same authorized case set to a documented disposition
Baseline method: Time the manual rider and checklist comparison
Venue Fit method: Time the reviewer using linked evidence
Pre-agreed rule: Agree a time threshold and rules for pauses before starting

Definition: Proposals independently accepted against final technical decisions and rental amendments
Venue Fit method: Count accepted options in the evidence workbench
Pre-agreed rule: Agree matching rules and eligible denominator before starting

Definition: Proposals claiming fit without sufficient documentary support or authority
Baseline method: Review the manual suggestions against the reference decision
Venue Fit method: Review each proposed fit and its supporting sources
Pre-agreed rule: Agree tolerance and escalation threshold before starting

Definition: Missed conflicts or false clearance with downstream rental or schedule impact
Baseline method: Review final amendments against the baseline advance file
Venue Fit method: Review the same adverse outcomes against the preview record
Pre-agreed rule: Agree stop criteria and severity definitions before starting

Definition: Budget owner reviews signed scope and results
Baseline method: Confirm season sample and commercial owner
Venue Fit method: Review comparative score and implementation effort
Pre-agreed rule: Confirm funded scope data permission reviewer and renewal owner before expansion
